# Pass One — Chessed Brainstorm

From nothing comes the frame, from frame the worlds may climb;
The Awtsmoos gives each vessel form, while motion flowers through time.

## Ideal creative vocabulary
- Movie -> acts -> scenes -> shots -> layers -> actors/primitives.
- 2D: vector shapes, paths, sprites, text, charts, callouts, masks, gradients, particles.
- 3D: meshes, lights, cameras, stages, instancing, particles, labels, spatial diagrams.
- Character rigs with poses, expressions, entrances, exits, dialogue/captions.
- Cameras with cuts, pans, dolly, orbit, crane, zoom, focus targets, shake.
- Keyframes plus higher-level actions: enter, exit, pulse, draw, type, count, morph, follow.
- Tutorials/infographics: arrows, braces, labels, timelines, bar/pie/line plots, comparison cards.
- Scene transitions: cut, fade, wipe, iris, slide, blur, flash.
- Audio-ready timeline metadata even if sound export is a separate concern.
- Deterministic seeded particles and procedural motion.
- AI schema with explicit defaults, validation, and bounded enumerations.
- Device-safe responsive stage framing and mobile control surfaces.
- JSON import/export so AI can emit movies without imperative DOM/WebGL code.
- Shared playback controls, scrubber, scene navigator, diagnostics, feature inspector.
- Long-form scene generator that proves duration and feature breadth.
- Renderer capability registry so 2D/3D can share concepts yet advertise differences.
- Graceful fallback when a renderer lacks an effect.

## Five competing architectures
A. One giant renderer with mode switches. Simple entry point, high coupling; reject unless reality forces it.
B. Shared schema + renderer adapters. Strong AI contract, distinct 2D/3D implementations; preferred.
C. Shared imperative timeline core + per-app helper APIs. Flexible, but AI generation is harder.
D. AST/compiler pipeline producing renderer-specific instructions. Powerful, more machinery.
E. Event-sourced movie graph interpreted by plugins. Extensible, potentially excessive today.

## Preferred hypothesis before inspection
Architecture B, optionally borrowing a small compiler normalization stage from D.
